test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A group of worshippers
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Congregation"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Congregation"** is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• **Congregation:** A gathering of people who have assembled in a place of worship to pray and worship.
 
 
• **Example: **The **congregation** were prompted to bow by the priest.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Posse: **A group of people chasing after someone to catch them.

 
 
• **Example:** To seek for the bandits, the sheriff rode off with his **posse.**
 
 
 
• **Caravan: **A group of individuals or animals going on an extended journey, particularly one through the desert.
 
 
• **Example:** Holiday **caravans** are permitted to park on the local farmer's property.
 
 
 
• **Constellation: **A group of stars that looks to represent a pattern or image.
 
 
• **Example: **One of the most significant **constellations** is Ursa Major, sometimes known as Big Bear.
